channels.raw_text:
Example recording, a synthetic narrator is reading Apple's fiscal 2025 third quarter release. This is not an executive recording. Apple today announced financial results for its fiscal 2025 third quarter ended June 28, 2025. The company posted quarterly revenue of 94.0 billion dollars, dollars, up 10% year over over year, and quarterly diluted earnings per share of 1.67 dollars, up 12% year over year.

We are very pleased with our record business performance for the June quarter, which generated EPS growth of 12%, said said Kevan Park, Apple's CFO.

End of example recording
channels.normalized_text:
Example recording, a synthetic narrator is reading Apple's fiscal 2025 Q3 release. This is not an executive recording. Apple today announced financial results for its fiscal 2025 Q3 ended June 28, 2025. The company posted quarterly revenue of 94.0 billion dollars, dollars, up 10% year over over year, and quarterly diluted earnings per share of 1.67 dollars, up 12% year over year.

We are very pleased with our record business performance for the June quarter, which generated EPS growth of 12%, said said Kevan Park, Apple's CFO.

End of example recording
channels.number_policy: Observed input values only; program normalization precedes extraction. SEC evidence is separate.
channels.decoded_audio: recreate with ingest; redundant WAV omitted from evidence commit

limitations: Heard/read numbers are input claims, never filing evidence.
Audio timestamps describe ASR turns, not individual words; speaker labels are not names or roles.
Video samples three frames at 1/6, 1/2 and 5/6 of duration; unsampled visuals can be missed.
Audio and frame claims are checked independently; no cross-modal identity or truth inference.
